meta.name: create-a-big-plan
meta.description: Create a large Prime Agent plan before implementation. Use for open-ended or high-risk repo efforts needing 10 or more planning questions, web research, reviewer or criticizer subagents, and refinement until convergence; exclude direct implementation-only, factual/explanation, trivial command-only, or explicit no-plan requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 开工前为高风险的仓库改造制定详尽计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对复杂任务时希望先定好完整方案再动手。
copy.tagline_en: Draft a thorough plan before coding large, high-risk tasks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you like to map out a full plan before tackling complex, high-risk work.

howto.what: 先只读检查目标仓库,初始化规划状态,逐个提出至少 10 个规划问题,结合网络研究,确认范围后写出 PLAN_v1.md,再用评审/批判子代理反复打磨到收敛,最后询问执行交接。
howto.when: 当你想在仓库改动前要一份大型、高风险或开放式计划时触发;这类任务通常需要至少 10 个规划问题、网络研究与评审打磨,而不处理直接实施、简单命令等请求。

say.text: 帮我把这次全仓重构制定成一份大计划
say.note: Claude会先检查仓库,然后开始逐个提问

say.text: 在改动前,创建一个big plan,先问够10个问题
say.note: 它会按流程走规划步骤并写PLAN_v1.md

say.text: 这个新系统风险高,请先做研究和评审再出计划
say.note: 会触发网络研究和评审收敛流程

howto.what_en: Read-only inspects repo, initializes state, asks ≥10 planning questions one by one, does web research, confirms scope, writes PLAN_v1.md, refines via reviewer/criticizer to convergence, then asks execution handoff.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants a large, high-risk, or open-ended plan before a repo change; excludes direct implementation, factual/explanation, and trivial command-only requests.

say_en.text: Turn this repo-wide refactor into a big plan first.
say_en.note: Claude inspects the repo and starts asking questions.

say_en.text: Before changing anything, create a big plan and ask at least 10 questions.
say_en.note: It follows the planning steps and writes PLAN_v1.md.

say_en.text: High-risk new system: please research and review before finalizing the plan.
say_en.note: Triggers web research and reviewer convergence.
